gfix-implement.title: GFIX feature_schema_version override must not break adapter configs: implement
gfix-implement.imperative: Dispatch a constellation-implementer subagent (model: sonnet) with a filled IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF. Fix the #369 regression in sampled_runtime._run_stage (lines ~446-449): the per-bundle manifest feature_schema_version is blanket-injected into every module's adapter Config via stage_overrides, breaking any recent-history config that does not declare the field (RaceStartRecentHistoryConfig and the other non-quali recent-history configs) -> TypeError aborts the whole sampled-runtime backtest. Root-cause fix: keep using feature_schema_version for the module_runtime consistency CHECK and the quali v1/v2 encoding selection, but do NOT pass it into adapter Config constructors that do not declare it. Cover ALL affected recent-history module families (confirm which configs reject it), not just race_start. Test-led (promoted runtime path): add a regression test exercising the _run_stage / sampled-backtest path with a race_start_recent_history module bundle carrying feature_schema_version, proving it failed before and passes after. Re-run the smoke Arm A sampled-backtest to show it now completes (no TypeError). Run simplification_limits on touched paths. Integrate IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.

preconditions.satisfied_by: G1 integrated; bug characterized (sampled_runtime._run_stage forwards feature_schema_version to adapter configs)

postconditions.statement: IMPLEMENTER_RESULT returned with no unresolved blockers
